judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a `.lore/dod.md` planning file and an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually implementing any of the feature. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is completely untouched, `ajv` was not added to `package.json`, and none of the documentation, specification (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, `.specify/spec.md`), or `CHANGELOG.md` files were updated. Because the implementation is missing, the newly added tests fail immediately and also violate the repository's `re-lint/require-spec-link` rule due to having no spec links. In addition, the candidate's test file was misnamed (`registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of `registry.test.ts`) and omitted the required `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` test and log-redaction check.
